cd ~/laguna-bench/runs/F2-6/repo; python - <<'E'
p='tests/integration/test_mindmap_workflows_e2e.py'
t=open(p).read()
a=t.index("        # role_restricted: a viewer")
b=t.index("        viewer_moves = await w.moves(w.c, node)")
new='''        # role_restricted: mindmap_work_list is scoped to the caller's own items, so the member
        # creates its own item first, then is demoted to viewer.
        c_map = (
            await MindmapOpenTool()(w.c, MindmapOpenInput(title="C plan", root_question="What?"))
        ).map_key
        c_node = await MindmapWriteNodeTool()(
            w.c, MindmapWriteNodeInput(map_key=c_map, content=f"C task {uuid4().hex[:6]}", node_role="position")
        )
        await MindmapWorkMarkTool()(w.c, MindmapWorkMarkInput(map_key=c_map, node_id=c_node.node_id, kind="story"))
        async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
            await conn.execute(
                "UPDATE team_role_assignments SET role_id = "
                "(SELECT id FROM roles_catalog WHERE role_key = 'viewer' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) "
                "WHERE parent_team_id = $1 AND member_id = $2",
                w.s["team"],
                w.s["tenant_c"],
            )
        c_item = (await MindmapWorkListTool()(w.c, MindmapWorkListInput(map_key=c_map))).items[0]
        viewer_moves = {m.to_stage: m for m in c_item.allowed_moves}
        assert viewer_moves["in_progress"].blocked_reason == "role_restricted"
        with pytest.raises(JsonRpcError) as exc:
            await MindmapWorkflowProposeMoveTool()(
                w.c,
                MindmapWorkflowProposeMoveInput(
                    map_key=c_map, node_id=UUID(str(c_node.node_id)), to_stage="in_progress", reason="x"
                ),
            )
        assert _data(exc.value)["code"] == "role_restricted"
'''
c=t.index("        assert await w.stage(node) == \"todo\"\n", b)
t=t[:a]+new+t[c:]
t=t.replace('assert _data(exc.value)["code"] in {"transition_not_found", "move_blocked"}','assert _data(exc.value)["code"] == "transition_not_found"')
open(p,'w').write(t)
E
pytest tests/integration/test_mindmap_workflows_e2e.py -q 2>&1 | tail -15

cd ~/laguna-bench/runs/F2-6/repo; cat > /tmp/edit.py <<'E'

''','''        other = await w.new_item("Other")
        unmapped = await w.new_item("Unmapped")
        await MindmapWorkSetStatusTool()(
            w.owner, MindmapWorkSetStatusInput(map_key=w.map_key, node_id=unmapped, status="in_progress")
        )
''',1)
t=t.replace('''        assert {node, other} <= set(items)''','''        assert {node, other, unmapped} <= set(items)
        assert items[unmapped].current_stage == "in_progress"
        assert items[unmapped].allowed_moves == []''',1)
t=t.replace('''        assert out.updated_count == 2
        assert await w.stage(node) == "backlog"
''','''        assert out.updated_count == 2
        assert await w.stage(node) == "backlog"
        assert await w.stage(other) == "backlog"
        # The unmapped item keeps its stage and still appears on the board with no moves.
        assert await w.stage(unmapped) == "in_progress"
        after = (await w.list_items(w.owner))[unmapped]
        assert after.current_stage == "in_progress"
        assert after.allowed_moves == []
''',1)
open(p,'w').write(t)
E
python /tmp/edit.py; pytest tests/integration/test_mindmap_workflows_e2e.py -q 2>&1 | tail -15; ruff check tests/integration/test_mindmap_workflows_e2e.py | tail -5
